source: Independent verification performed by the parallel sessions arena/27a86924-own1, arena/90c9f78c-own1 and arena/85ca8130-own1, recorded in research/SOURCES.md, EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md (earlier build) and data/entries.json of the archived Prize Atlas dashboard.
method: Their checked rows and their source audit were re-read and carried over verbatim. Nothing was re-worded into a stronger claim; where they recorded a caveat, the caveat is carried with the fact. These are reported as an independent session's checks, not as checks made by this session, and they are labelled that way on every page.
